newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Kaikai up 19.53 pct at midday on debut.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Kaikai up 19.53 pct at midday on debut.

text.p: Clothes maker Shanghai Kaikai Industrial Co Ltd, whose 80 million B shares debuted on Wednesday on the Shanghai stock exchange, surged 19.53 percent to $0.306 against an issue price of $0.256 at midday.
Volume was very heavy at 7.3 million shares, two-thirds of combined volume of 12.8 million shares on the Shanghai B share market by midday on Wednesday.
Traders said Kaikai's issue price was very low, giving it an price earnings ratio on issue of only seven times, leaving substantial room for rises.
The stock opened at an intra-day low of $0.288, hitting an intra-day high of $0.318 before edging down due to profit-taking, they said.
The stock would have risen even further if there had not been an announcement on Tuesday by the securities authorities that 33 more companies had been chosen for B share listings, the said.
Traders expect the Kaikai stock to stay around the $0.300 level for the rest of session.
Shanghai Kaikai Industrial Co Ltd is one of China's largest shirt and sweater makers. It claims a 5.7 percent share of the national market for shirts and 2.5 percent for sweaters.
